content.text: How does `iwe find --meta` filter documents? Trace the data flow from CLI argument parsing through to the filtered result set. List every function involved and explain the filtering logic. Do not modify any files.

arguments.command: cd /tmp/bench-iwe-explore-1-cvocAv && sqlite3 .codeindex.db "SELECT file, line, content FROM lines WHERE content LIKE '%meta%' AND (file LIKE '%find%' OR file LIKE '%cli%' OR file LIKE '%arg%') ORDER BY file, line" 2>/dev/null | head -60
